verdict.rationale: Swell's backend API docs state that official libraries are available for Node and PHP. The documented secret-key and basic-auth scheme, with separate test and live keys, shows how those SDKs authenticate against the API. Missing for 10: SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python, Go, a dedicated frontend/storefront JS SDK), in-depth SDK reference documentation, a published OpenAPI spec for generating typed clients (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
